import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

base = Path(&#34;scripts/ModelShapValues/shap_output/kfzteile24/test_features&#34;)
df = pd.read_csv(base / &#34;comparison_mean_abs_shap.csv&#34;)

# Short setting labels
short = {
    &#34;2026-09-07_new_models_with_landingpage_lstm&#34;: &#34;lstm_w_lp&#34;,
    &#34;2026-09-08_best_models_without_landingpage_xgb&#34;: &#34;xgb_best_no_lp&#34;,
    &#34;2026-09-09_best_models_with_landingpage_cat_enables_xgb&#34;: &#34;xgb_best_w_lp&#34;,
    &#34;2026-09-09_new_models_without_landingpage_xgb&#34;: &#34;xgb_new_no_lp&#34;,
}
df[&#34;setting&#34;] = df[&#34;customer_setting&#34;].map(short)

# For LSTM there are two model variants (50 and 100) - average or take max?
# Show both counts
print(&#34;=== Rows per setting/role/model ===&#34;)
print(df.groupby([&#34;setting&#34;,&#34;role&#34;,&#34;model_path&#34;]).size().reset_index(name=&#34;n_features&#34;).to_string(index=False))

print(&#34;\n=== Unique features per setting ===&#34;)
print(df.groupby(&#34;setting&#34;)[&#34;feature&#34;].apply(lambda s: sorted(s.unique())).to_string())

# Prefer one model per setting/role: for LSTM take the 50 variant (matches mean_abs files), 
# for XGB there&#39;s one. Detect by filename.
df[&#34;model_tag&#34;] = df[&#34;model_path&#34;].apply(lambda p: &#34;lstm50&#34; if &#34;NNLSTM_50&#34; in p else (&#34;lstm100&#34; if &#34;NNLSTM_100&#34; in p else &#34;xgb&#34;))

# Use lstm50 + xgb for fair single-model view
df1 = df[df[&#34;model_tag&#34;].isin([&#34;lstm50&#34;,&#34;xgb&#34;])].copy()

**Browsing intensity drives all four kfzteile24 settings**; landing-page only matters when explicitly enabled in XGB.

Open the full breakdown beside the chat: [kfzteile24 SHAP summary](/Users/karolinegriesbach/.cursor/projects/Users-karolinegriesbach-Documents-Innkeepr-Git-evaluation-and-execution-scripts/canvases/kfzteile24-shap-summary.canvas.tsx) (a live canvas for the charts and tables).

### Scope
CV fold 6 on `test_features`: LSTM with `landingpage_cat` (n=200), plus three XGB settings (n=300) — best without LP, best with `landingpage`, new without LP. Roles: control / treatment / conversion.

### Main findings
1. **Page features dominate** — ~55–90% of total mean |SHAP| across roles; session duration is usually second.
2. **Landing signal is setting-dependent** — `landingpage` in XGB best+LP is **#2** for control/treatment (~25–28% of |SHAP|). LSTM’s `landingpage_cat` stays weak (ranks 5–6, ~4–7%).
3. **LSTM vs XGB differ on history** — LSTM leans on cumulated page counts; XGB prefers spot counts (`pages_visited_per_session` / `_per_user`). Session-cumulated is near noise in XGB.
4. **Recency is conversion-specific for XGB** — `days_between_sessions` is #2 on both no-LP conversion models (20–31%).
5. **Caveat** — XGB best+LP **treatment** looks degenerate (total |SHAP| ~0.06; cumulated features exactly 0). Also don’t compare raw |SHAP| across LSTM vs XGB or conversion vs group models (different scales).

          <H3>{"2. Landing-page signal is setting-dependent"}</H3>
          <Text>{"When a landing feature is present, its control share ranges from 15% to 43% of total mean |SHAP|. Without it, that budget is absorbed by page-count / duration features."}</Text>

          <H3>{"3. LSTM vs XGB use history differently"}</H3>
          <Text>{"Compare top-1 features: LSTM often elevates cumulated page counts; XGB more often prefers spot counts (pages_visited_per_session / _per_user). Use within-model shares — absolute |SHAP| is not comparable across backends."}</Text>

          <H3>{"4. Recency can matter for conversion"}</H3>
          <Text>{"XGB best no LP puts recency at 19% of conversion |SHAP|. Check days_between_sessions before discarding it."}</Text>

          <H3>{"5. Possible degenerate treatment model: LSTM new + LP"}</H3>
          <Text>{"Treatment total mean |SHAP| is far below other settings. Inspect whether the model under-fits or SHAP sampling hit a flat region; cumulated features at exactly 0 are a red flag."}</Text>

          <H3>{"6. Do not compare raw |SHAP| across roles/backends"}</H3>
          <Text>{"Conversion heads (especially XGB) often have much larger absolute SHAP totals than control/treatment or LSTM probability outputs. Compare ranks or within-model percentage shares only."}</Text>

Created `scripts/ModelShapValues/write_shap_canvas_report.py`. It takes a SHAP results directory and writes a Cursor canvas report.

### Usage

```bash
python scripts/ModelShapValues/write_shap_canvas_report.py \
  --shap-results scripts/ModelShapValues/shap_output/kfzteile24/kfzteile24_6835d77813526dc3d1229978_test_data

  --shap-results /path/to/shap_output/<customer>/<data_stem> \
  --output /Users/<you>/.cursor/projects/<workspace>/canvases/my-report.canvas.tsx \
  --title "kfzteile24 SHAP evaluation" \
  --cv 6
```

### Behavior
- **Input:** `--shap-results` directory
- **Reads:** `comparison_mean_abs_shap.csv` if present, otherwise aggregates `**/cv_*_*_mean_abs_shap.csv`; uses `shap_run_manifest.csv` for sample sizes when available
- **Output:** `.canvas.tsx` with scope, feature-family mix charts, top-1 table, control |SHAP| bars, landing ranks, and auto findings
- **Default path:** Cursor workspace `canvases/` when found, else next to the SHAP results

_**User**_

what does this mean? Page features (control)

---

_**Agent (default)**_

**Page features (control)** is the share of total mean |SHAP| on the **control** model that comes from **page-visit features** (e.g. `pages_visited_per_session`, `pages_visited_per_user`, and their cumulated variants).

- **Page features** = browsing intensity / how many pages were viewed  
- **Control** = the model that predicts outcome in the control group (not treatment, not the conversion head)  
- The percentage (e.g. `4–48%` for tchibo) = how much of that control model’s feature importance is carried by those page features across settings

So for tchibo, in one setting pages barely matter for control (~4%), and in the other they matter a lot more (~48%) — because with landingpage enabled, landing takes a large share of the importance instead.

_**Agent (default)**_

You're right that 200 is small relative to the full dataset (~834k rows) — but it only applies to the **LSTM** settings, not XGB.

What happened:
1. The run used `--max-samples all` (~834k rows).
2. For LSTM, `GradientExplainer` failed (`'NoneType' object cannot be interpreted as an integer`).
3. The script fell back to `KernelExplainer`, which is expensive, so it hard-caps at **200 rows**:

```593:598:scripts/ModelShapValues/calculate_shap_values.py
        # KernelExplainer is expensive — explain a smaller subset if needed
        explain_n = min(len(x_plot), 200)
        x_small = x_plot.iloc[:explain_n].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
        bg_2d = x_plot.iloc[bg_idx].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
        explainer = shap.KernelExplainer(predict_fn, bg_2d)
        values = explainer.shap_values(x_small, nsamples=100)
```

By contrast, **XGB** used the full **833,906** rows (native `pred_contribs`, no KernelExplainer).

So in the canvas “Sample n” column: LSTM ≈ 200 (fallback cap), XGB ≈ 834k (full data). The 200 is a cost safeguard after GradientExplainer failed, not the intended sample size.

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROLES = (&#34;control&#34;, &#34;treatment&#34;, &#34;conversion&#34;)
BUCKETS = (&#34;pages&#34;, &#34;duration&#34;, &#34;landing&#34;, &#34;recency&#34;, &#34;other&#34;)
BUCKET_COLORS = {
    &#34;pages&#34;: &#34;#3B82F6&#34;,
    &#34;duration&#34;: &#34;#6B7280&#34;,
    &#34;landing&#34;: &#34;#10B981&#34;,
    &#34;recency&#34;: &#34;#F59E0B&#34;,
    &#34;other&#34;: &#34;#EF4444&#34;,
}
BUCKET_LABELS = {
    &#34;pages&#34;: &#34;Pages visited&#34;,
    &#34;duration&#34;: &#34;Session duration&#34;,
    &#34;landing&#34;: &#34;Landing&#34;,
    &#34;recency&#34;: &#34;Recency&#34;,
    &#34;other&#34;: &#34;Other&#34;,
}


def slugify(text: str) -&gt; str:
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r&#34;[^a-z0-9]+&#34;, &#34;-&#34;, text).strip(&#34;-&#34;)


def short_setting_label(setting: str) -&gt; str:
    s = re.sub(r&#34;^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}_&#34;, &#34;&#34;, setting)
    parts = []
    if &#34;lstm&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;LSTM&#34;)
    elif &#34;xgb&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;XGB&#34;)
    if &#34;best_models&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;best&#34;)
    elif &#34;new_models&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;new&#34;)
    if &#34;without_landingpage&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;no LP&#34;)
    elif &#34;landingpage&#34; in s:
        parts.append(&#34;+ LP&#34;)
    return &#34; &#34;.join(parts) if parts else setting[-40:]


def feature_bucket(feature: str) -&gt; str:
    f = feature.lower()
    if &#34;landing&#34; in f:
        return &#34;landing&#34;
    if f == &#34;days_between_sessions&#34; or f.startswith(&#34;days_&#34;):
        return &#34;recency&#34;
    if &#34;session_duration&#34; in f or &#34;duration_in_s&#34; in f:
        return &#34;duration&#34;
    if &#34;pages_visited&#34; in f or &#34;page&#34; in f:
        return &#34;pages&#34;
    return &#34;other&#34;


def esc(text: str) -&gt; str:
    return (
        str(text)
        .replace(&#34;&amp;&#34;, &#34;&amp;amp;&#34;)
        .replace(&#34;&lt;&#34;, &#34;&amp;lt;&#34;)
        .replace(&#34;&gt;&#34;, &#34;&amp;gt;&#34;)
        .replace(&#39;&#34;&#39;, &#34;&amp;quot;&#34;)
    )


def load_rows(shap_results: Path) -&gt; list[dict]:
    comparison = shap_results / &#34;comparison_mean_abs_shap.csv&#34;
    rows: list[dict] = []
    if comparison.is_file():
        with comparison.open(newline=&#34;&#34;, encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;) as f:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
        src = comparison.name
    else:
        files = sorted(shap_results.glob(&#34;**/cv_*_*_mean_abs_shap.csv&#34;))
        if not files:
            raise SystemExit(f&#34;No SHAP CSVs under {shap_results}&#34;)
        for path in files:
            with path.open(newline=&#34;&#34;, encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;) as f:
                rows.extend(csv.DictReader(f))
        src = f&#34;{len(files)} mean_abs CSV(s)&#34;
    for r in rows:
        r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] = float(r.get(&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;) or 0)
        r[&#34;mean_shap&#34;] = float(r[&#34;mean_shap&#34;]) if r.get(&#34;mean_shap&#34;) not in (None, &#34;&#34;) else float(&#34;nan&#34;)
        r[&#34;role&#34;] = (r.get(&#34;role&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).lower()
        r[&#34;_src&#34;] = src
    return rows


def load_manifest_n(shap_results: Path) -&gt; dict[str, int]:
    path = shap_results / &#34;shap_run_manifest.csv&#34;
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    out: dict[str, int] = {}
    with path.open(newline=&#34;&#34;, encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;) as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            setting = r.get(&#34;setting&#34;) or r.get(&#34;customer_setting&#34;)
            if setting and setting not in out:
                try:
                    out[setting] = int(float(r.get(&#34;n_rows&#34;) or 0))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    return out


def model_priority(model_path: str) -&gt; tuple[int, str]:
    p = str(model_path)
    if &#34;NNLSTM_50&#34; in p:
        return (0, p)
    if &#34;NNLSTM_100&#34; in p:
        return (1, p)
    return (0, p)


def dedupe(rows: list[dict]) -&gt; list[dict]:
    groups: dict[tuple, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        key = (r.get(&#34;customer_setting&#34;), r.get(&#34;cv&#34;), r.get(&#34;role&#34;))
        groups[key].append(r)
    out = []
    for _, group in groups.items():
        paths = sorted({str(r.get(&#34;model_path&#34;) or &#34;&#34;) for r in group}, key=model_priority)
        best = paths[0]
        out.extend([r for r in group if str(r.get(&#34;model_path&#34;) or &#34;&#34;) == best])
    return out


def pct(part: float, total: float) -&gt; float:
    return round(100.0 * part / total, 1) if total &gt; 0 else 0.0


def html_table(headers: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -&gt; str:
    th = &#34;&#34;.join(f&#34;&lt;th&gt;{esc(h)}&lt;/th&gt;&#34; for h in headers)
    body = []
    for row in rows:
        body.append(&#34;&lt;tr&gt;&#34; + &#34;&#34;.join(f&#34;&lt;td&gt;{esc(c)}&lt;/td&gt;&#34; for c in row) + &#34;&lt;/tr&gt;&#34;)
    return f&#34;&lt;table&gt;&lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;{th}&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt;&lt;tbody&gt;{&#39;&#39;.join(body)}&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#34;


def build_and_write(shap_results: Path, title: str, html_out: Path) -&gt; None:
    rows = dedupe(load_rows(shap_results))
    src = rows[0][&#34;_src&#34;] if rows else &#34;&#34;
    n_by_setting = load_manifest_n(shap_results)

    setting_order = sorted({r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] for r in rows})
    labels_raw = [short_setting_label(s) for s in setting_order]
    if len(set(labels_raw)) &lt; len(labels_raw):
        label_of = {s: f&#34;{short_setting_label(s)} · {s[:10]}&#34; for s in setting_order}
    else:
        label_of = {s: short_setting_label(s) for s in setting_order}
    settings = [label_of[s] for s in setting_order]

    # scope
    scope_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        sub = [r for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting]
        backends = sorted({r.get(&#34;backend&#34;) or &#34;&#34; for r in sub if r.get(&#34;backend&#34;)})
        feats = sorted({r[&#34;feature&#34;] for r in sub})
        landing = [f for f in feats if &#34;landing&#34; in f.lower()]
        n = n_by_setting.get(setting, -1)
        scope_rows.append(
            [setting, &#34;, &#34;.join(backends) or &#34;—&#34;, &#34;, &#34;.join(landing) if landing else &#34;—&#34;, str(n) if n &gt; 0 else &#34;—&#34;]
        )

    # bucket shares
    bucket_shares: dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]] = {}
    for role in ROLES:
        shares = {b: [] for b in BUCKETS}
        for setting in setting_order:
            g = [r for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and r[&#34;role&#34;] == role]
            total = sum(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g)
            for b in BUCKETS:
                part = sum(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g if feature_bucket(r[&#34;feature&#34;]) == b)
                shares[b].append(pct(part, total))
        bucket_shares[role] = shares

    # top1
    top1_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        row = [label_of[setting]]
        for role in ROLES:
            g = [r for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and r[&#34;role&#34;] == role]
            if not g:
                row.append(&#34;—&#34;)
                continue
            top = max(g, key=lambda r: r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;])
            row.append(top[&#34;feature&#34;])
        top1_rows.append(row)

    # landing
    landing_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        landing_feats = sorted(
            {r[&#34;feature&#34;] for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and &#34;landing&#34; in r[&#34;feature&#34;].lower()}
        )
        for feat in landing_feats:
            cells = [label_of[setting], feat]
            for role in ROLES:
                g = sorted(
                    [r for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and r[&#34;role&#34;] == role],
                    key=lambda r: -r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;],
                )
                if not g or feat not in {r[&#34;feature&#34;] for r in g}:
                    cells.append(&#34;—&#34;)
                    continue
                ranks = {r[&#34;feature&#34;]: i + 1 for i, r in enumerate(g)}
                total = sum(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g)
                val = next(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g if r[&#34;feature&#34;] == feat)
                cells.append(f&#34;rank {ranks[feat]}/{len(g)} · {pct(val, total)}%&#34;)
            landing_rows.append(cells)

    # control chart features
    control = [r for r in rows if r[&#34;role&#34;] == &#34;control&#34;]
    feat_totals: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in control:
        feat_totals[r[&#34;feature&#34;]].append(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;])
    ranked = sorted(feat_totals, key=lambda f: -sum(feat_totals[f]) / len(feat_totals[f]))
    control_features = ranked[:8]
    for f in sorted({r[&#34;feature&#34;] for r in control if &#34;landing&#34; in r[&#34;feature&#34;].lower()}):
        if f not in control_features:
            control_features.append(f)

    control_series = []
    palette = [&#34;#3B82F6&#34;, &#34;#6B7280&#34;, &#34;#10B981&#34;, &#34;#F59E0B&#34;, &#34;#EF4444&#34;, &#34;#8B5CF6&#34;]
    for i, setting in enumerate(setting_order):
        by_feat = {
            r[&#34;feature&#34;]: r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;]
            for r in control
            if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting
        }
        control_series.append(
            {
                &#34;name&#34;: label_of[setting],
                &#34;data&#34;: [by_feat.get(f, 0.0) for f in control_features],
                &#34;color&#34;: palette[i % len(palette)],
            }
        )

    pages_control = bucket_shares[&#34;control&#34;][&#34;pages&#34;]
    pages_lo = min(pages_control) if pages_control else 0
    pages_hi = max(pages_control) if pages_control else 0
    landing_control_shares = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        g = [r for r in rows if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and r[&#34;role&#34;] == &#34;control&#34;]
        total = sum(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g)
        part = sum(r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;] for r in g if feature_bucket(r[&#34;feature&#34;]) == &#34;landing&#34;)
        if part &gt; 0:
            landing_control_shares.append(pct(part, total))
    best_landing = max(landing_control_shares) if landing_control_shares else 0.0
    weak_landing = min(landing_control_shares) if landing_control_shares else 0.0

    treatment_totals = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        total = sum(
            r[&#34;mean_abs_shap&#34;]
            for r in rows
            if r[&#34;customer_setting&#34;] == setting and r[&#34;role&#34;] == &#34;treatment&#34;
        )
        treatment_totals.append((label_of[setting], total))
    degenerate = &#34;none&#34;
    if treatment_totals:
        vals = [t for _, t in treatment_totals]
        med = sorted(vals)[len(vals) // 2]
        for label, total in treatment_totals:
            if med &gt; 0 and total &lt; 0.15 * med:
                degenerate = label
                break

    findings = [
        (
            &#34;Engagement is the backbone&#34;,
            f&#34;Page-visit features account for about {pages_lo:.0f}–{pages_hi:.0f}% of control mean |SHAP| across settings.&#34;,
        )
    ]
    if landing_rows:
        findings.append(
            (
                &#34;Landing-page signal is setting-dependent&#34;,
                f&#34;When present, landing control share ranges from {weak_landing:.0f}% to {best_landing:.0f}% of total mean |SHAP|.&#34;,
            )
        )
    findings.append(
        (
            &#34;Sample n caveat&#34;,
            &#34;LSTM sample n of 200 usually means KernelExplainer fallback after GradientExplainer failed; XGB may use the full dataset (~800k+).&#34;,
        )
    )
    findings.append(
        (
            &#34;Do not compare raw |SHAP| across roles/backends&#34;,
            &#34;Compare ranks or within-model percentage shares only.&#34;,
        )
    )
    takeaway = (
        f&#34;For {title.split(&#39; SHAP&#39;)[0]}, lead with page-visit / session-duration features. &#34;
        &#34;Treat landing as high-value when it ranks in the top half for control/treatment.&#34;
    )

    active_buckets = [
        b
        for b in BUCKETS
        if b != &#34;other&#34;
        or any(any(v != 0 for v in bucket_shares[role][b]) for role in ROLES)
    ]

    def stacked(role: str) -&gt; str:
        parts = []
        for b in active_buckets:
            parts.append(
                &#34;{&#34;
                f&#39;label:{json.dumps(BUCKET_LABELS[b])},&#39;
                f&#34;data:{json.dumps(bucket_shares[role][b])},&#34;
                f&#39;backgroundColor:{json.dumps(BUCKET_COLORS[b])},&#39;
                &#34;stack:&#39;share&#39;&#34;
                &#34;}&#34;
            )
        return &#34;[&#34; + &#34;,&#34;.join(parts) + &#34;]&#34;

    control_datasets = &#34;,&#34;.join(
        &#34;{&#34;
        f&#39;label:{json.dumps(s[&#34;name&#34;])},&#39;
        f&#39;data:{json.dumps(s[&#34;data&#34;])},&#39;
        f&#39;backgroundColor:{json.dumps(s[&#34;color&#34;])}&#39;
        &#34;}&#34;
        for s in control_series
    )

    chart_blocks = &#34;&#34;.join(
        f&#39;&lt;div class=&#34;card&#34;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;{role.capitalize()} models&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;canvas id=&#34;chart-{role}&#34; height=&#34;120&#34;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#39;
        for role in ROLES
    )
    chart_inits = &#34;&#34;.join(
        f&#34;&#34;&#34;
  new Chart(document.getElementById(&#39;chart-{role}&#39;), {{
    type: &#39;bar&#39;,
    data: {{ labels: {json.dumps(settings)}, datasets: {stacked(role)} }},
    options: {{
      responsive: true,
      scales: {{
        x: {{ stacked: true }},
        y: {{ stacked: true, max: 100, title: {{ display: true, text: &#39;% of mean |SHAP|&#39; }} }}
      }}
    }}
  }});&#34;&#34;&#34;
        for role in ROLES
    )

    findings_html = &#34;&#34;.join(
        f&#34;&lt;div class=&#39;finding&#39;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;{esc(f&#39;{i}. {t}&#39;)}&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;{esc(b)}&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#34;
        for i, (t, b) in enumerate(findings, 1)
    )
    landing_section = &#34;&#34;
    if landing_rows:
        landing_section = f&#34;&lt;section&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Landing-page signal&lt;/h2&gt;{html_table([&#39;Setting&#39;,&#39;Feature&#39;,&#39;Control share&#39;,&#39;Treatment share&#39;,&#39;Conversion share&#39;], landing_rows)}&lt;/section&gt;&#34;

    source_label = f&#34;{shap_results.as_posix().split(&#39;scripts/&#39;)[-1] if &#39;scripts/&#39; in shap_results.as_posix() else shap_results} · {src}&#34;

&lt;html lang=&#34;en&#34;&gt;
&lt;head&gt;

    .stats {{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:16px 0 24px; }}
    .stat,.card,.callout,.finding {{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; }}
    .stat .value {{ font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:700; }}
    .stat .label {{ color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:4px; }}

    table {{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem; display:block; overflow:auto; }}

python3 << 'PY'
"""Stdlib-only SHAP HTML export (pandas unavailable/segfaulting)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROLES = ("control", "treatment", "conversion")
BUCKETS = ("pages", "duration", "landing", "recency", "other")
BUCKET_COLORS = {
    "pages": "#3B82F6",
    "duration": "#6B7280",
    "landing": "#10B981",
    "recency": "#F59E0B",
    "other": "#EF4444",
}
BUCKET_LABELS = {
    "pages": "Pages visited",
    "duration": "Session duration",
    "landing": "Landing",
    "recency": "Recency",
    "other": "Other",
}


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")


def short_setting_label(setting: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}_", "", setting)
    parts = []
    if "lstm" in s:
        parts.append("LSTM")
    elif "xgb" in s:
        parts.append("XGB")
    if "best_models" in s:
        parts.append("best")
    elif "new_models" in s:
        parts.append("new")
    if "without_landingpage" in s:
        parts.append("no LP")
    elif "landingpage" in s:
        parts.append("+ LP")
    return " ".join(parts) if parts else setting[-40:]


def feature_bucket(feature: str) -> str:
    f = feature.lower()
    if "landing" in f:
        return "landing"
    if f == "days_between_sessions" or f.startswith("days_"):
        return "recency"
    if "session_duration" in f or "duration_in_s" in f:
        return "duration"
    if "pages_visited" in f or "page" in f:
        return "pages"
    return "other"


def esc(text: str) -> str:
    return (
        str(text)
        .replace("&", "&amp;")
        .replace("<", "&lt;")
        .replace(">", "&gt;")
        .replace('"', "&quot;")
    )


def load_rows(shap_results: Path) -> list[dict]:
    comparison = shap_results / "comparison_mean_abs_shap.csv"
    rows: list[dict] = []
    if comparison.is_file():
        with comparison.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
        src = comparison.name
    else:
        files = sorted(shap_results.glob("**/cv_*_*_mean_abs_shap.csv"))
        if not files:
            raise SystemExit(f"No SHAP CSVs under {shap_results}")
        for path in files:
            with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                rows.extend(csv.DictReader(f))
        src = f"{len(files)} mean_abs CSV(s)"
    for r in rows:
        r["mean_abs_shap"] = float(r.get("mean_abs_shap") or 0)
        r["mean_shap"] = float(r["mean_shap"]) if r.get("mean_shap") not in (None, "") else float("nan")
        r["role"] = (r.get("role") or "").lower()
        r["_src"] = src
    return rows


def load_manifest_n(shap_results: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    path = shap_results / "shap_run_manifest.csv"
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    out: dict[str, int] = {}
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            setting = r.get("setting") or r.get("customer_setting")
            if setting and setting not in out:
                try:
                    out[setting] = int(float(r.get("n_rows") or 0))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    return out


def model_priority(model_path: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    p = str(model_path)
    if "NNLSTM_50" in p:
        return (0, p)
    if "NNLSTM_100" in p:
        return (1, p)
    return (0, p)


def dedupe(rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    groups: dict[tuple, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        key = (r.get("customer_setting"), r.get("cv"), r.get("role"))
        groups[key].append(r)
    out = []
    for _, group in groups.items():
        paths = sorted({str(r.get("model_path") or "") for r in group}, key=model_priority)
        best = paths[0]
        out.extend([r for r in group if str(r.get("model_path") or "") == best])
    return out


def pct(part: float, total: float) -> float:
    return round(100.0 * part / total, 1) if total > 0 else 0.0


def html_table(headers: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:
    th = "".join(f"<th>{esc(h)}</th>" for h in headers)
    body = []
    for row in rows:
        body.append("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{esc(c)}</td>" for c in row) + "</tr>")
    return f"<table><thead><tr>{th}</tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(body)}</tbody></table>"


def build_and_write(shap_results: Path, title: str, html_out: Path) -> None:
    rows = dedupe(load_rows(shap_results))
    src = rows[0]["_src"] if rows else ""
    n_by_setting = load_manifest_n(shap_results)

    setting_order = sorted({r["customer_setting"] for r in rows})
    labels_raw = [short_setting_label(s) for s in setting_order]
    if len(set(labels_raw)) < len(labels_raw):
        label_of = {s: f"{short_setting_label(s)} · {s[:10]}" for s in setting_order}
    else:
        label_of = {s: short_setting_label(s) for s in setting_order}
    settings = [label_of[s] for s in setting_order]

    # scope
    scope_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        sub = [r for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting]
        backends = sorted({r.get("backend") or "" for r in sub if r.get("backend")})
        feats = sorted({r["feature"] for r in sub})
        landing = [f for f in feats if "landing" in f.lower()]
        n = n_by_setting.get(setting, -1)
        scope_rows.append(
            [setting, ", ".join(backends) or "—", ", ".join(landing) if landing else "—", str(n) if n > 0 else "—"]
        )

    # bucket shares
    bucket_shares: dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]] = {}
    for role in ROLES:
        shares = {b: [] for b in BUCKETS}
        for setting in setting_order:
            g = [r for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting and r["role"] == role]
            total = sum(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g)
            for b in BUCKETS:
                part = sum(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g if feature_bucket(r["feature"]) == b)
                shares[b].append(pct(part, total))
        bucket_shares[role] = shares

    # top1
    top1_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        row = [label_of[setting]]
        for role in ROLES:
            g = [r for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting and r["role"] == role]
            if not g:
                row.append("—")
                continue
            top = max(g, key=lambda r: r["mean_abs_shap"])
            row.append(top["feature"])
        top1_rows.append(row)

    # landing
    landing_rows = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        landing_feats = sorted(
            {r["feature"] for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting and "landing" in r["feature"].lower()}
        )
        for feat in landing_feats:
            cells = [label_of[setting], feat]
            for role in ROLES:
                g = sorted(
                    [r for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting and r["role"] == role],
                    key=lambda r: -r["mean_abs_shap"],
                )
                if not g or feat not in {r["feature"] for r in g}:
                    cells.append("—")
                    continue
                ranks = {r["feature"]: i + 1 for i, r in enumerate(g)}
                total = sum(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g)
                val = next(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g if r["feature"] == feat)
                cells.append(f"rank {ranks[feat]}/{len(g)} · {pct(val, total)}%")
            landing_rows.append(cells)

    # control chart features
    control = [r for r in rows if r["role"] == "control"]
    feat_totals: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in control:
        feat_totals[r["feature"]].append(r["mean_abs_shap"])
    ranked = sorted(feat_totals, key=lambda f: -sum(feat_totals[f]) / len(feat_totals[f]))
    control_features = ranked[:8]
    for f in sorted({r["feature"] for r in control if "landing" in r["feature"].lower()}):
        if f not in control_features:
            control_features.append(f)

    control_series = []
    palette = ["#3B82F6", "#6B7280", "#10B981", "#F59E0B", "#EF4444", "#8B5CF6"]
    for i, setting in enumerate(setting_order):
        by_feat = {
            r["feature"]: r["mean_abs_shap"]
            for r in control
            if r["customer_setting"] == setting
        }
        control_series.append(
            {
                "name": label_of[setting],
                "data": [by_feat.get(f, 0.0) for f in control_features],
                "color": palette[i % len(palette)],
            }
        )

    pages_control = bucket_shares["control"]["pages"]
    pages_lo = min(pages_control) if pages_control else 0
    pages_hi = max(pages_control) if pages_control else 0
    landing_control_shares = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        g = [r for r in rows if r["customer_setting"] == setting and r["role"] == "control"]
        total = sum(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g)
        part = sum(r["mean_abs_shap"] for r in g if feature_bucket(r["feature"]) == "landing")
        if part > 0:
            landing_control_shares.append(pct(part, total))
    best_landing = max(landing_control_shares) if landing_control_shares else 0.0
    weak_landing = min(landing_control_shares) if landing_control_shares else 0.0

    treatment_totals = []
    for setting in setting_order:
        total = sum(
            r["mean_abs_shap"]
            for r in rows
            if r["customer_setting"] == setting and r["role"] == "treatment"
        )
        treatment_totals.append((label_of[setting], total))
    degenerate = "none"
    if treatment_totals:
        vals = [t for _, t in treatment_totals]
        med = sorted(vals)[len(vals) // 2]
        for label, total in treatment_totals:
            if med > 0 and total < 0.15 * med:
                degenerate = label
                break

    findings = [
        (
            "Engagement is the backbone",
            f"Page-visit features account for about {pages_lo:.0f}–{pages_hi:.0f}% of control mean |SHAP| across settings.",
        )
    ]
    if landing_rows:
        findings.append(
            (
                "Landing-page signal is setting-dependent",
                f"When present, landing control share ranges from {weak_landing:.0f}% to {best_landing:.0f}% of total mean |SHAP|.",
            )
        )
    findings.append(
        (
            "Sample n caveat",
            "LSTM sample n of 200 usually means KernelExplainer fallback after GradientExplainer failed; XGB may use the full dataset (~800k+).",
        )
    )
    findings.append(
        (
            "Do not compare raw |SHAP| across roles/backends",
            "Compare ranks or within-model percentage shares only.",
        )
    )
    takeaway = (
        f"For {title.split(' SHAP')[0]}, lead with page-visit / session-duration features. "
        "Treat landing as high-value when it ranks in the top half for control/treatment."
    )

    active_buckets = [
        b
        for b in BUCKETS
        if b != "other"
        or any(any(v != 0 for v in bucket_shares[role][b]) for role in ROLES)
    ]

    def stacked(role: str) -> str:
        parts = []
        for b in active_buckets:
            parts.append(
                "{"
                f'label:{json.dumps(BUCKET_LABELS[b])},'
                f"data:{json.dumps(bucket_shares[role][b])},"
                f'backgroundColor:{json.dumps(BUCKET_COLORS[b])},'
                "stack:'share'"
                "}"
            )
        return "[" + ",".join(parts) + "]"

    control_datasets = ",".join(
        "{"
        f'label:{json.dumps(s["name"])},'
        f'data:{json.dumps(s["data"])},'
        f'backgroundColor:{json.dumps(s["color"])}'
        "}"
        for s in control_series
    )

    chart_blocks = "".join(
        f'<div class="card"><h3>{role.capitalize()} models</h3><canvas id="chart-{role}" height="120"></canvas></div>'
        for role in ROLES
    )
    chart_inits = "".join(
        f"""
  new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-{role}'), {{
    type: 'bar',
    data: {{ labels: {json.dumps(settings)}, datasets: {stacked(role)} }},
    options: {{
      responsive: true,
      scales: {{
        x: {{ stacked: true }},
        y: {{ stacked: true, max: 100, title: {{ display: true, text: '% of mean |SHAP|' }} }}
      }}
    }}
  }});"""
        for role in ROLES
    )

    findings_html = "".join(
        f"<div class='finding'><h3>{esc(f'{i}. {t}')}</h3><p>{esc(b)}</p></div>"
        for i, (t, b) in enumerate(findings, 1)
    )
    landing_section = ""
    if landing_rows:
        landing_section = f"<section><h2>Landing-page signal</h2>{html_table(['Setting','Feature','Control share','Treatment share','Conversion share'], landing_rows)}</section>"

    source_label = f"{shap_results.as_posix().split('scripts/')[-1] if 'scripts/' in shap_results.as_posix() else shap_results} · {src}"
    # prefer relative
    try:
        from pathlib import Path as P
        repo = P('.').resolve()
        source_label = f"{shap_results.resolve().relative_to(repo)} · {src}"
    except Exception:
        pass

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>{esc(title)}</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    :root {{ --bg:#0b0d10; --panel:#14181f; --text:#e8eaed; --muted:#9aa3af; --border:#2a3140; }}
    * {{ box-sizing: border-box; }}
    body {{ margin:0; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); line-height:1.45; }}
    main {{ max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:32px 20px 64px; }}
    h1 {{ font-size:1.75rem; margin:0 0 8px; }}
    h2 {{ font-size:1.25rem; margin:32px 0 12px; }}
    h3 {{ font-size:1rem; margin:0 0 12px; }}
    .muted {{ color:var(--muted); font-size:0.9rem; }}
    .pills {{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:12px 0 20px; }}
    .pill {{ border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--muted); }}
    .stats {{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:16px 0 24px; }}
    .stat,.card,.callout,.finding {{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; }}
    .stat .value {{ font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:700; }}
    .stat .label {{ color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:4px; }}
    .callout {{ margin:12px 0 24px; color:var(--muted); }}
    table {{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem; display:block; overflow:auto; }}
    th,td {{ border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); text-align:left; padding:8px 10px; vertical-align:top; white-space:pre-wrap; }}
    th {{ color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; }}
    .grid {{ display:grid; gap:16px; }}
    .finding {{ margin-bottom:10px; }}
    .finding p {{ margin:6px 0 0; color:var(--muted); }}
    footer {{ margin-top:32px; color:var(--muted); font-size:0.75rem; }}
    @media (max-width:800px) {{ .stats {{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }} }}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <h1>{esc(title)}</h1>
    <p class="muted">{esc(source_label)}</p>
    <div class="pills">
      <span class="pill">{len(settings)} settings</span>
      <span class="pill">control · treatment · conversion</span>
      {"<span class='pill'>landing feature present</span>" if landing_rows else ""}
    </div>
    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat"><div class="value">{esc(f"{pages_lo:.0f}–{pages_hi:.0f}%")}</div><div class="label">Page features (control)</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="value">{esc(f"{best_landing:.0f}%" if landing_control_shares else "n/a")}</div><div class="label">Best landing share (control)</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="value">{esc(f"{weak_landing:.0f}%" if landing_control_shares else "n/a")}</div><div class="label">Weakest landing share (control)</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="value">{esc(degenerate)}</div><div class="label">Degenerate treatment flag</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="callout">
      Absolute SHAP magnitudes are not comparable across LSTM vs XGB or conversion vs group models — use ranks and within-model shares.
      LSTM sample n of 200 usually means KernelExplainer fallback; XGB may use the full dataset.
    </div>
    <section><h2>Scope</h2>{html_table(["Setting","Backend","Landing feature","Sample n"], scope_rows)}</section>
    <section>
      <h2>Feature-family mix by role</h2>
      <p class="muted">Share of total mean |SHAP| (%).</p>
      <div class="grid">{chart_blocks}</div>
    </section>
    <section><h2>What dominates each model</h2>{html_table(["Setting","Control #1","Treatment #1","Conversion #1"], top1_rows)}</section>
    <section>
      <h2>Control: mean |SHAP| by feature</h2>
      <p class="muted">Use ranks within a series.</p>
      <div class="card"><canvas id="chart-control-features" height="160"></canvas></div>
    </section>
    {landing_section}
    <section><h2>Findings &amp; caveats</h2>{findings_html}</section>
    <section><h2>Practical takeaway</h2><div class="card"><p>{esc(takeaway)}</p></div></section>
    <footer>{esc(source_label)}</footer>
  </main>
  <script>
{chart_inits}
  new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-control-features'), {{
    type: 'bar',
    data: {{ labels: {json.dumps(control_features)}, datasets: [{control_datasets}] }},
    options: {{
      indexAxis: 'y',
      responsive: true,
      scales: {{ x: {{ title: {{ display: true, text: 'Mean |SHAP|' }} }} }}
    }}
  }});
  </script>
</body>
</html>
